body_lead: Assam govt eyes satellite, AI surveillance to detect early forest encroachment CM Sarma said that deploying forest guards and other officials alone would not be sufficient to prevent encroachment without technological intervention Guwahati, Oct 23: The Assam government on Friday stressed the use of satellite technology and artificial intelligence (AI) to detect and prevent the earliest signs of encroachment in reserved forests.
